prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: ONE opaque full-bleed landscape visual-novel quest panel, 16:9, request1536x864. A graphic INK DRAWING with FLAT COLOUR, not a realistic painting. No panels, borders, lettering or interface.

Warwrit scene: a lived-in medieval river village of modest weathered timber houses on stilts. Foreground wooden boardwalk, cold ash-grey marsh water and muted ochre reeds; a low narrow stake-marked causeway recedes toward a misty marsh in the middle distance. Damp dusk. ONE small warm house window, otherwise slate-grey dusk with no fiery sunset. Practical wooden construction, broad calm water reflections, a clear path out into the marsh.

Exactly TWO adult people, both fully in frame. Vera~50, narrow lined face, rust-red wool headscarf tied under chin, worn brown wool coat, urgently offers a LARGE COILED HEMP ROPE held visibly between both hands at waist height. Exactly TWO separate bundled heavy fishing nets rest side by side on the boardwalk beside her feet; their broad folded net mesh and rope-bound bundles are unmistakable, distinct from the hand-held rope coil. She faces the listening mercenary and does NOT point away. Mercenary~35, short dark hair and dark stubble, weathered face, brown quilted coat, plain worn ROUND WOODEN SHIELD on left arm, practical short straight sword SHEATHED at belt, leather boots. He is turned three-quarters toward Vera, listening without a heroic pose. Natural human adult anatomy and purposeful hands. No additional people, no children, no monsters, no stranded villagers revealed.

Technique is essential: confident irregular black/brown INK CONTOURS define faces, hands, clothing silhouettes and major structural edges. Use only THREE TO FOUR LARGE FLAT VALUE SHAPES per material, opaque matte colour washes, coherent shadow blocks, very few selective folds and large quilt seams. The coat panels are simple flat brown washes. Skin is three broad warm planes with economical facial lines. Timber is a few flat grey/umber planes with selected worn edges. Water and sky are calm flat shapes. Background houses simplify into readable dark masses, distant reeds into broad silhouettes. There is NO photographic shading, no cloth fibres, no skin pores, no rendered fleece, no every-shingle tracing, no wood-grain carpet, no stipple, no fine uniform hatch, no painterly microtexture, no glossy CGI. Adult serious dark fantasy with the restraint and legibility of a professionally inked graphic novel.

Palette: soot, slate, umber, restrained ochre, muted moss olive; one rust-red scarf and naturally readable skin. Three distinct foreground/middle/distant value planes, clean silhouette separation. Strongest local contrast on faces/hands/rope; fishing nets and causeway are clear secondary cues. Keep secondary surfaces quiet instead of filling them with detail.

Composition: eye-level medium-wide view, Vera left of centre, mercenary right of centre, marsh causeway clearly visible beside them. Complete figures from heads through boots inside the central80 percent of image height; both net bundles also inside that safe region so a wide reader cannot crop them away. Faces remain readable. Boardwalk grounds every boot and bundle. One coherent cold sky light plus the small warm window. No blank banner or reserved text rectangle.

Avoid text, letters, runes, emblems, logos, watermark, decorative frames, collage, speech bubbles, extra figures, corpses, gore, oversized weapons, toy buildings, pristine masonry, vivid green lawns, sparkling highlights and busy evenly distributed detail. Show the equipment offer NOW, not a rescue or chosen outcome.
